user_scope: Detailed method/equations, one cold single batch, then immediate continuation into sequential with the same frozen policy

geometry.protection: all-valid-token native rewrite contexts and canonical, old/new teacher-forcing paths
geometry.space: D = D Q; D K_E = 0; D = D P_star
geometry.rank_threshold: original EN FP64 rank rule; unresolved ranks are technical failures

reference.base_eligibility: source-verified answer and wrong challenger; W0 prefers answer over fixed challenger
reference.conflicts: exclude same-subject aliases, overwritten facts, and metadata-known dependent facts; do not silently replace during a batch
reference.general_document_KL: C4 Dev128 observer only; existing held-out records never repurposed as train

challenger.candidates: fixed verified c0 plus current-request new targets verified wrong for this record
challenger.selection: maximum first-answer-token likelihood at native preview, tie by stable target hash
challenger.limitations: proxy only; shared-first-token candidates tied; no claim of full-answer maximum

reference.bound: same-function same-challenger value at own batch entry

history.registry: all observed latest active request versions
history.memory_selection: stable-hash priority among latest active records
history.screen_selection: deterministic rotating window in memory hash order
history.inactive_screen_guard: q_candidate <= max(q_entry,q_native)+epsilon and no additional native preference/strict ID losses
history.overwrite: exclude old version before controller, atomically commit latest version with weights/history/cache

selection.candidate_unit: record and A/M constraint row, not document or fact count
selection.shortlist: largest actual native violations; stable hash ties
selection.active_seed: largest violation with nonzero projected gradient
selection.active_greedy: max-min cosine distance in projected gradient space; ties by violation and stable hash
selection.claim: GSS-inspired budgeted selection, not exact GSS feasible-cone optimization
selection.unreachable_rows: record separately and retain in full-bank diagnostics

solver.second_linearization_condition: first physical candidate fails active finite constraints and no technical error
solver.dual: min_alpha>=0 0.5 alpha^T G alpha - d^T alpha
solver.infeasible_behavior: native fallback with explicit unresolved constraint status
solver.technical_failure_behavior: abort cell, no scientific success or fallback claim
solver.materialization: from immutable native FP32 weights, verify actual stored delta

execution.location: server1, one matched GPU/runtime for both arms
execution.order: existing O0 first1000; first100 is already observed development data
technical_checks_inside_P1: two legal directions at two finite-difference step sizes

evaluation.current_each_batch: R/P/N at write; N also at entry
evaluation.cost: both standalone editing and total research cost, shared native counted explicitly

readiness.CPU_math_checks: separate receipt; does not certify model readiness

supersession_reason: User replaced factual-label/entry-NLL bounds with fixed W0 greedy-choice protection. The interrupted v1 document and contract had different selection settings; neither is an execution contract.
